name: Three sensors on netsim
description: Peripheral-only, because on netsim the Android emulator (or Bumble, or another netsim client) plays the central. Each device names the node label it registers under, so `netsim devices` lists something a human can tell apart. Needs netsimd with its WebSocket frontend: netsimd --logtostderr --no-shutdown --ws-port 7681.
